prior_year_events.impact_description: Described in the report as a devastating California wildfires event contributing to US catastrophe-related losses

named_events.loss_description: describing another year of devastating California wildfires as the reinsurers suffered losses in excess of USD 100bn

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 70.9m. The syndicate experienced significant US catastrophe activity (including California wildfires) during the period; the report describes heavy US catastrophe related losses across the year. The report does not provide an explicit gross-figure for prior-year reserve movement in the dedicated movement note that could be unambiguously extracted; therefore a quantified gross prior-year development figure could not be determined from the available pages.
raw_causal_phrases: After a second consecutive year of heavy US catastrophe related losses
another year of devastating California wildfires
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding (70.9) taken from the Technical Provisions / Claims outstanding table (page 25). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' amount could be clearly located on the available pages; only net development/triangles and P&L 'claims incurred in prior underwriting years' items are visible and those P&L lines are excluded per instructions. A net claims development triangle (net of reinsurance) is present (page 21) and a gross closing movement (70.9 -> 52.4) implies an overall decrease in gross claims, but that is not necessarily equal to prior-year development. Prior-year development is therefore left null. Certain table numbers (claims triangle) were partially legible; where possible gross opening/closing balances were used. Users should verify prior-year movement from the full Technical Reserves note in the original PDF.
